incidents.summary: CAB Payments shareholders alleged that its IPO prospectus inadequately disclosed risks in its West African markets and called for a regulatory investigation into whether investors were misled.

sources.title: Risks in CAB Payments float ‘not fully disclosed’, investors claim
sources.quote: Shareholders in CAB Payments have called on regulators to investigate whether the prospectus for one of London’s biggest stock market flops this year misled investors.

sources.title: Risks in CAB Payments float ‘not fully disclosed’, investors claim
sources.quote: RC Brown and Polar Capital, two small investment funds that featured in the top 20 shareholders in the company, are understood to be among those alleging that the risks in its west African markets were not fully disclosed.
